decisions.reason: The same source message already directly updates the Small Block draw condition and no-referral ticket assignment; no additional or incomplete candidate Event remains.
The existing same-message About-page Event already incorporates the exact Big Block draw wording and no-code ticket-allocation copy.

The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY changing the no-code commission recipient to a random existing ticket holder; the Big Block draw-trigger change does not otherwise alter commission allocation.
Message 156 revises the About page rather than the approved FAQ, so the Big Block mechanism change does not necessarily modify the FAQ requirement at this time.
The Big Block draw and no-referral ticket changes do not alter coded-referral commission behavior; the message's separate unlimited and no-expiration commission statements are already recorded.
The source leaves automatic prize delivery versus one-click claiming unresolved, and the candidate already records that ambiguity; the Big Block draw modification does not resolve it.
Changing the Big Block draw trigger and assigning its no-referral ticket does not change the per-primary-sale revenue amounts or prize-pool recipients.
Secondary sales remain qualifying sales for the Big Block draw, and the source does not change royalty amount, enforcement, funding, or ticket-generation behavior.
The source changes Big Block draw and no-referral assignment rules but does not change what book, referral code, badges, or ticket state transfers with an NFT.
The source does not change the referral code's mint-number identity, permanence, or display locations.
The Big Block draw and no-referral ticket changes do not alter the Aave provider or prize-pool yield behavior.
The Big Block ticket counter remains required, and the source does not change which reward counters or permanent badges must appear in NFT metadata.
